release_tag_envelope.why_two_bindings: A manifest committed into cybrik-suite cannot name its own SHA, and pre-merge PR heads are rewritten by rebase. The content-base pins therefore record what was evaluated; the external release tag records what was released. Reading a content-base pin as a released SHA is a category error (ABMB-04).
